$schema.name: The Paddock — Machine Repository
$schema.purpose: Canonical, growing record of every machine covered in The Paddock: premium, beautiful and powerful motorcycles and cars. This file is the single source of truth. The homepage hero, the paddock rail, machines.html and every article in articles/machines/ are all presentations of the records below.
$schema.supersedes: data/motorcycles.json (v1, motorcycles only — removed in v2)
howToAddAMachine: 1. Add a record to `machines` below, following the field contract.
2. Save a verified image of the ACTUAL model to assets/images/bikes/ or assets/images/cars/ and record its source and licence.
3. Write the article from scripts/machine-article-template.html into articles/machines/<slug>.html.
5. To feature it on the homepage, set its id as section.machineOfTheMoment.

fieldContract.id: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never change once published.
fieldContract.image: Repo-relative path. Image MUST be of the actual named model and visually verified before commit.
fieldContract.imageVerified: true only after a human or agent has actually looked at the image and confirmed the model.
fieldContract.article: Repo-relative path to the long-form article.
fieldContract.sourcing: Per-market availability. 'availability' must be honest, including when a machine is not officially sold in a market.
fieldContract.productionStatus: 'current' if the machine is still in production, or 'ended-<year>' if it is not. When production has ended, sourcing rows must describe the used/remaining-stock reality rather than implying a showroom purchase.

$schema.pricingDisclaimer: All prices are indicative and approximate as of early 2026. Actual prices vary by market, specification, options, dealer, local taxes and import duties, and change without notice. Figures are given to convey order of magnitude, not to quote a transaction. Always confirm with an official dealer.
$schema.editorialRule: The content in this section must never be wrong. Prefer a qualitative statement over an uncertain number. Never invent dealer names, stock figures, or quotes attributed to real people.

section.label: The Paddock
section.title: Machines of the Moment
section.description: The most beautiful and most powerful machines in the world — motorcycles and cars — each with the full story behind it.

machines.name: Royal Enfield Classic 650
machines.cardDescription: The postwar silhouette of the original Classic, carried by the smoothest parallel twin Enfield has ever built. Chrome tank, hand-striped panels — a machine that looks inherited, not bought.
machines.imageSource: Official Royal Enfield product gallery (royalenfield.com), Classic 650 in Teal

pricing.note: The most attainable machine in The Paddock — deliberately so.

sourcing.availability: Widely available through Royal Enfield's national dealer network
Official dealers across most EU markets
Official distributor in Dubai and Abu Dhabi

uniquePoints: Royal Enfield is the oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, dating to 1901.
Hand-applied pinstriping on the tank — a human hand touches every bike.
Offers genuine period looks at roughly a fifth the price of its European heritage rivals.

machines.name: Ducati Panigale V4
machines.cardDescription: Bologna's latest masterwork — a sculpture that happens to produce over 200 horsepower. The aluminium monocoque refined into something close to jewellery.
machines.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: 'Ducati Panigale V4S 2025.jpg' by AVMOTO

pricing.note: S and R specifications carry a substantial premium over the base machine.

sourcing.availability: Ducati India dealerships in major metros; CBU import
Official distributor, Dubai and Abu Dhabi

uniquePoints: Desmodromic valve actuation — valves are closed mechanically, not by springs. Ducati is effectively alone in using it on road bikes.
Counter-rotating crankshaft, borrowed directly from Ducati's MotoGP programme.
Named after Borgo Panigale, the Bologna district where every Ducati is built.

machines.name: BMW R 12 nineT
machines.cardDescription: Bavaria's love letter to its own history. The boxer twin sits in the frame like an heirloom watch in a display case — engineering as quiet confidence.
machines.imageSource: Wikimedia Commons: '2024-06 BMW R12-nineT right.jpg' by Wikisympathisant

pricing.note: Option 719 finishes and billet packs raise the figure considerably.

sourcing.availability: BMW Motorrad India, CBU import; limited dealer footprint

uniquePoints: The boxer twin layout has been a BMW constant since the R 32 of 1923 — over a century of the same architecture.
The flat twin's low centre of gravity is a genuine handling advantage, not a styling accident.
Designed from the outset to be customised; BMW publishes the bike as a platform.

machines.name: Moto Guzzi V7 Special
machines.cardDescription: Built on the shores of Lake Como since 1921 — the oldest European motorcycle factory in continuous operation. Italian craft at its most unhurried.

pricing.note: Among the most affordable ways into genuine European motorcycling heritage.

sourcing.availability: Official dealers; footprint smaller than Japanese rivals
Not officially sold; grey import only

uniquePoints: The transverse V-twin places both cylinders directly in the airstream — a layout almost unique to Moto Guzzi.
Still built in the original Mandello del Lario factory, in operation since 1921.
The eagle emblem honours Giovanni Ravelli, a founding partner who died before the company began.

machines.name: Norton Commando 961
machines.launched: Relaunched 2023 under TVS Motor Company ownership; production confirmed ended in 2025
machines.cardDescription: Hand-assembled in Solihull, polished like regimental silver. Now out of production — every 961 that will exist already does.

pricing.indicative: Approx. £16,500–17,000 at 2023 list; now used-market only
pricing.note: Production has ended, so this is a used and remaining-stock market. Values are set by condition and history, not a price list.

sourcing.availability: Strongest market. Established dealers and the deepest used supply; any new bikes are remaining stock.
sourcing.indicativePrice: ≈ £16,500 (SP) / £17,000 (CR) at 2023 list; used values vary widely

sourcing.availability: Limited. Thin dealer presence; many buyers source from the UK.
Restricted. No conventional retail network; import and compliance apply.
Very limited. Norton is owned by TVS Motor Company, but the 961 was never a volume model here.
sourcing.indicativePrice: Confirm with distributor; expect import duties

sourcing.availability: Limited official presence; used and private import are the realistic routes.

uniquePoints: Norton traces to 1898 — one of the oldest names in motorcycling.
The original 1967 Commando's Isolastic system rubber-mounted the engine to tame parallel-twin vibration, a genuine engineering innovation.
Built in very small numbers by hand; each machine is effectively individually assembled.
Production ended in 2025, so the total number of 961s that will ever exist is now fixed.

machines.name: Ferrari 12Cilindri
machines.cardDescription: A naturally aspirated V12 in an age that has all but outlawed them. Named simply for its twelve cylinders, because nothing else needed saying.

pricing.note: For Ferrari, allocation matters as much as price — the list figure is only the beginning of the conversation.

sourcing.availability: Official dealers in Dubai and Abu Dhabi; a strong V12 market
Official Ferrari presence; import duties roughly double the landed cost

uniquePoints: One of the last naturally aspirated V12s on sale — no turbochargers, no hybrid assistance.
The black band across the nose is a deliberate reference to the 365 GTB/4 Daytona's visor.
Ferrari's V12 lineage is unbroken from the 125 S of 1947, the company's first car.

machines.name: Aston Martin Vanquish
machines.cardDescription: The most old-money car in production. British coachbuilding sensibility wrapped around twelve cylinders, built in strictly limited numbers.

pricing.note: Q by Aston Martin commissioning can raise the final figure very substantially.

sourcing.availability: Official Aston Martin dealers; home market
Official dealers in Dubai and Abu Dhabi
Limited official presence; import duties roughly double the landed cost

uniquePoints: Aston Martin took its name from the Aston Clinton hillclimb and founder Lionel Martin.
Q by Aston Martin will build essentially bespoke commissions — closer to Savile Row than a configurator.
One of the very few manufacturers still committing to a twelve-cylinder flagship.

machines.name: Lamborghini Revuelto
machines.cardDescription: The first V12 hybrid Lamborghini. A thousand horsepower, scissor doors, and not one gram of restraint — the collection's statement of raw power.

pricing.note: Options and long waiting lists are the norm; few cars leave the factory at base specification.

sourcing.availability: Official Lamborghini dealers; long waiting list
Official dealers; one of the brand's strongest markets
Official Lamborghini India presence; import duties roughly double the landed cost

uniquePoints: Lamborghini's first V12 hybrid — electrification used to add power, not to replace the engine.
Scissor doors have been a Lamborghini V12 signature since the Countach of the 1970s.
'Revuelto' follows the house tradition of naming cars after fighting bulls.
